title: Lancet: Accelerating Mixture-of-Experts Training via Whole Graph Computation-Communication Overlapping
problem: Mixture-of-Experts training incurs frequent communication between experts and parameter servers, creating synchronization bottlenecks where computation and communication happen sequentially. This sequential execution limits training throughput and scalability.
motivation: Reducing MoE training time accelerates convergence of large-scale models like modern LLMs, enabling faster experimentation and deployment.
method: Lancet overlaps computation and communication across the entire MoE computation graph by using pipelining and scheduling to identify independent computation that can proceed while communication is in flight. The system coordinates overlapping at whole-graph level to hide communication latency behind useful work.
key_novelty: Whole-graph computation-communication overlapping strategy specifically targeting MoE training patterns rather than layer-by-layer or point-wise overlapping.
contributions: Computation-communication overlap technique for complete MoE training graphs
Scheduling algorithm to identify and coordinate overlappable operations
Training acceleration demonstrated on MoE-based models
Likely integration with distributed training frameworks
primary_theme: Overlapping computation and communication for accelerated MoE training
